title.zh: 何恺明团队新作：看猫片就能学会ARC挑战
title.en: 何恺明团队新作：看猫片就能学会ARC挑战

current_state.zh: He Kaiming's team published a method that learns from ordinary cat videos to acquire visual representations strong enough to tackle ARC-style abstract reasoning tasks, suggesting scalable video pretraining can transfer to general reasoning.
